name: ks-name-rule
what: The C04 name rule: what the service accepts as the name of a project, a session, an agent or a key alias, 1 to 48 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter. The service's rule is checked against these cases by ctl's tests; the client vendors this file and checks every new name it sends against the same cases, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed.
